fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to every enemy in it and making each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Dire Quack
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Damped] for 8 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rank Plumage
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to the attacker, who is set [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Reek
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health forms for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
